entities.summary: Miroslav Maratovich Nemirov was a Russian poet, associated with Russian punk rock, born in Rostov-on-Don. He is most known as a founder of Instruktsiya po Vyzhivaniyu rock group in 1985 in Tyumen and the author of the Great Tyumen Encyclopaedia, as well as being a regular columnist of Russian Journal between 2000 and 2003. He collaborated with Grazhdanskaya Oborona as well. Miroslav Nemirov was a architects & engineers from Rostov-on-Don (1961-11-08, Rostov-on-Don–2016-02-21). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
